title: Strata: Hierarchical Context Caching for Long Context Language Model Serving
technique: GPU-assisted I/O to decouple GPU/CPU KV layouts plus cache-aware scheduling (delay-hit deferral, balanced prefill batches, stall hiding with decode) on SGLang

optimized_metrics.evidence: Strata is designed to improve long-context serving by reducing response latency and increasing overall throughput. Accordingly, we evaluate the system using two primary metrics: average Time To First Token (TTFT) and output token throughput.

Strata is designed to improve long-context serving by reducing response latency and increasing overall throughput. Accordingly, we evaluate the system using two primary metrics: average Time To First Token (TTFT) and output token throughput.

headline_claim.text: Strata achieves up to 5x lower Time-To-First-Token (TTFT) compared to vLLM + LMCache and 3.75x speedup over NVIDIA TensorRT-LLM on long-context benchmarks, without degrading short-context performance.

reported_metrics.where: Fig 3 PCIe bandwidth utilization; I/O stall %

metric_definitions.definition_quote: TTFT captures query response time, a key determinant of user experience
metric_definitions.notes: Not formally defined; includes cache-load stalls and queueing under Poisson arrivals (in-flight cap 128).

metric_definitions.definition_quote: output token throughput is a widely adopted metric for characterizing LLM serving system performance
metric_definitions.notes: Output tokens only. Results given as throughput at the same TTFT (throughput-latency curves), e.g. 'up to 3.2x higher throughput at the same TTFT'.

load_regime: request-rate sweep (Poisson arrivals), in-flight cap 128; 60 s think time for ShareGPT multi-turn
tradeoff_acknowledged: Larger KV page sizes raise transfer efficiency but lower cache hit rate and raise average and P90 TTFT (Fig 2); Strata aims for no short-context degradation
extractor_notes: Mean TTFT is the optimization target; P90 TTFT appears only in motivation. Headline '3.75x speedup' vs TensorRT-LLM is throughput at same TTFT (Llama-70B), not TTFT directly.
load_class_quote: we simulate query arrivals using a Poisson distribution to benchmark the system using varying request rates (§5.1)
